title: More pictured details on five early log buildings
items: The infant school has larger openings, a dark doorway and log courses across its front gable.
Cobweb Castle uses its reconstructed centre, wings and tails; Miller House has a boarded upper storey.
Carpenter’s shop has taller sash and a roof-piercing chimney. Wolf Point has an L-shaped body, rounded logs, recessed entries and its sign pole.
Sources and liberties distinguish pictured details from reconstructed dimensions. These buildings still differ from their reference images.
